# env/components-creds.example.txt — infra-creds template for 12-media (### NN_Service format).
#
# REAL secrets go in env/components-creds.txt (GITIGNORED) — never in this committed
# .example file. Workflow:
#   cp env/components-creds.example.txt env/components-creds.txt
#   $EDITOR env/components-creds.txt        # paste your REAL infra creds (the full ### dump)
#   chmod 600 env/components-creds.txt
#   ./env/init-env.sh .env.dev             # renders env/.env.dev
#
# init-env.sh reads env/components-creds.txt (gitignored). Paste your FULL infra status
# dump (all ### blocks); 12-media uses only these:
#   01_PostgreSQL 02_MongoDB 05_Kafka 07_Elastic_APM 10_RustFS.
# Other blocks are ignored — including 03_Elasticsearch (:9201), which is the
# search/review business ES used ONLY by 05-search + 08-review. The application
# LOG-SINK ES is the APM-stack ES (block 07_Elastic_APM, :9200).
#
# 12-media is VERIFY-ONLY: it does NOT mint JWT keys. Paste 01-auth's rendered
# JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 + INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN into the ### Auth_Identity block below
# (from 01-auth's env/.env.dev). It never generates a keypair.

### 01_PostgreSQL
   endpoint       postgresql://postgres:CHANGE_ME@<host>:5432/postgres
   host:port      <host>:5432
   user           postgres
   password       CHANGE_ME

### 02_MongoDB
   endpoint       mongodb://dokandar:CHANGE_ME@<host>:27017/?authSource=admin
   host:port      <host>:27017
   user           dokandar
   password       CHANGE_ME

### 05_Kafka
   bootstrap      <host>:9092
   ui             http://<host>:8080
   auth           none (PLAINTEXT)

### 07_Elastic_APM
   elasticsearch  http://elastic:CHANGE_ME@<host>:9200
   apm-ingest     http://<host>:8200  (Bearer token)
   apm-token      CHANGE_ME
   kibana-ui      http://<host>:5601  (login: elastic)
   elastic-pass   CHANGE_ME
   kibana_system  CHANGE_ME

### 10_RustFS
   s3-endpoint    http://<host>:9002
   console-ui     http://<host>:9001
   access-key     CHANGE_ME
   secret-key     CHANGE_ME

### Auth_Identity        # NOT present for 01-auth (it MINTS these)
   auth_service_public_key   <paste 01-auth .env.dev JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64>
   internal_service_token    <paste 01-auth .env.dev INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN>
